fusions.name: Startled Flock
fusions.desc: Flushes a flock that hits every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 12 damage and knocking them back 2 tiles. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Carrion Call
fusions.desc: Scavengers from the ground and the sky fall on a dying enemy for 26 damage, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Hop, Flap, Gone
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 8% for 8 seconds, and carries you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Glide Into the Bite
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your crit chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.
